CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.adjust_inventory_level(p_product_id uuid, p_variant_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_location_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_adjustment integer DEFAULT 0, p_actor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT 'adjustment'::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_request_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_product RECORD;
    v_location_id UUID;
    v_level RECORD;
    v_next_available INTEGER;
    v_level_json JSONB;
    v_adjustment_id UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT id, store_id
      INTO v_product
      FROM products
     WHERE id = p_product_id
       AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'product not found';
    END IF;

    PERFORM public.require_inventory_site_guc(v_product.store_id);

    IF p_location_id IS NULL THEN
        v_location_id := ensure_default_inventory_location(v_product.store_id);
    ELSE
        SELECT id
          INTO v_location_id
          FROM inventory_locations
         WHERE id = p_location_id
           AND store_id = v_product.store_id
           AND deleted_at IS NULL;

        IF v_location_id IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory location not found for product store';
        END IF;
    END IF;

    SELECT *
      INTO v_level
      FROM inventory_levels
     WHERE product_id = p_product_id
       AND location_id = v_location_id
       AND (
            (p_variant_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL)
            OR variant_id = p_variant_id
       )
     LIMIT 1
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        v_next_available := p_adjustment;
        IF v_next_available < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot reduce inventory below zero';
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO inventory_levels (
            product_id,
            variant_id,
            location_id,
            available,
            reserved,
            incoming,
            updated_at
        )
        VALUES (
            p_product_id,
            p_variant_id,
            v_location_id,
            v_next_available,
            0,
            0,
            NOW()
        )
        RETURNING * INTO v_level;
    ELSE
        v_next_available := COALESCE(v_level.available, 0) + p_adjustment;

        IF v_next_available < 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot reduce inventory below zero';
        END IF;

        IF v_next_available < COALESCE(v_level.reserved, 0) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'available inventory cannot be below reserved quantity';
        END IF;

        UPDATE inventory_levels
           SET available = v_next_available,
               updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = v_level.id
         RETURNING * INTO v_level;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO inventory_adjustments (
        product_id,
        variant_id,
        location_id,
        quantity_change,
        reason,
        note,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_product_id,
        p_variant_id,
        v_location_id,
        p_adjustment,
        CASE
            WHEN p_reason IN ('sale', 'return', 'adjustment', 'recount', 'transfer', 'damaged', 'reserved', 'unreserved')
            THEN p_reason
            ELSE 'adjustment'
        END,
        p_notes,
        p_actor_id
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_adjustment_id;

    PERFORM public.sync_inventory_catalog_cache_v1(p_product_id,p_variant_id);

    INSERT INTO outbox_events (
        store_id,
        aggregate_type,
        aggregate_id,
        event_type,
        payload,
        idempotency_key,
        request_id,
        actor_id
    )
    VALUES (
        v_product.store_id,
        'inventory',
        p_product_id::TEXT,
        'inventory.level.adjusted',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'store_id', v_product.store_id,
            'product_id', p_product_id,
            'variant_id', p_variant_id,
            'location_id', v_location_id,
            'adjustment', p_adjustment,
            'available', v_next_available
        ),
        'inventory.level.adjusted:audit:' || v_adjustment_id::TEXT,
        p_request_id,
        p_actor_id
    );

    SELECT to_jsonb(v_level) INTO v_level_json;
    RETURN v_level_json;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.product_edit_snapshot_v1(p_product_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    SELECT to_jsonb(p) || jsonb_build_object(
        'product_options', coalesce(o.items, '[]'::jsonb), 'options', coalesce(o.items, '[]'::jsonb),
        'variants', coalesce(v.items, '[]'::jsonb), 'product_variants', coalesce(v.items, '[]'::jsonb))
    FROM public.products p
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(po) ORDER BY po.position, po.id) AS items,
            array_agg(po.name ORDER BY po.position, po.id) AS names
        FROM public.product_options po WHERE po.product_id = p.id
    ) o ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'id', pv.id, 'product_id', pv.product_id, 'title', pv.title,
            'price', pv.price, 'compare_price', pv.compare_price, 'sku', pv.sku, 'barcode', pv.barcode,
            'stock', pv.inventory_qty, 'inventory_qty', pv.inventory_qty, 'inventory_quantity', pv.inventory_qty,
            'weight', pv.weight, 'weight_unit', pv.weight_unit, 'image_url', pv.image_url, 'position', pv.position,
            'metadata', pv.metadata,
            'option1', pv.option1, 'option2', pv.option2, 'option3', pv.option3,
            'options', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                coalesce(o.names[1], 'Option 1'), pv.option1,
                coalesce(o.names[2], 'Option 2'), pv.option2,
                coalesce(o.names[3], 'Option 3'), pv.option3))) ORDER BY pv.position, pv.id) AS items
        FROM public.product_variants pv WHERE pv.product_id = p.id
    ) v ON true
    WHERE p.id = p_product_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL;
$function$
